provider.name: Integrated Taxonomic Information System
provider.organization_type: governmental and international taxonomic-name, classification, identifier, common-name, jurisdiction, source, expert, download, and web-service infrastructure
provider.description: The Integrated Taxonomic Information System provides authoritative and documented taxonomic information for plants, animals, fungi, and other organisms. ITIS assigns Taxonomic Serial Numbers, maintains accepted names, synonyms, classifications, authorship, common names, jurisdictions, origins, credibility ratings, taxonomic experts, sources, downloadable database snapshots, and JSON and SOAP web services.
institutional_context: Taxonomic experts, museums, universities, and biodiversity institutions

purpose.summary: This file is a crawl-ready source catalog for collecting ITIS documentation, TSN records, classifications, accepted names, synonyms, common names, jurisdictions, sources, experts, quality ratings, web services, downloads, schemas, standards, licenses, citations, partner institutions, and related taxonomic authorities.
purpose.authoritative_notice: ITIS, its participating agencies, taxonomic experts, official downloads, web-service documentation, cited publications, and related authorities remain authoritative for names, TSNs, classifications, statuses, quality ratings, versions, licenses, citations, and contacts.
